what year was the game \"overwatch\" rev: Blizzard revealed Overwatch at BlizzCon in November 2014, and the team shooter launched in May 2016. It grew out of the company's cancelled MMO project, Titan.
which of the following is not a faction: The Division (2016) is set in a New York overrun by a deadly virus released on Black Friday. Its enemy groups include Rioters, Cleaners, the Rikers and the Last Man Battalion, but the CDC is not one of its factions.
in undertale, what's the prize for answe: Undertale is a 2015 indie RPG by Toby Fox, famous for its humor and for letting players spare enemies instead of fighting them. Its quirky dialogue and surprises are a big part of its charm.
what minimum level in the defence skill: In RuneScape, armor tiers require set Defence levels: rune armor needs level 40, and dragon armor needs level 60. Higher tiers are meant to take more time to unlock.
before it's redesign of the company logo: Before its 2000 redesign, the EA logo was a set of 3D shapes: a cube, a sphere and a cone. A cylinder was never part of it.
who is the leader of team valor in pokém: Candela is the leader of Team Valor in Pokémon Go, the red team. Blanche leads Team Mystic and Spark leads Team Instinct.
what is the name of the adventurer you m: In Stardew Valley, Marlon runs the Adventurer's Guild near the mines. He sells weapons and gives out rewards for slaying monsters.
in the game nuclear throne, what charact: Nuclear Throne is a fast top-down shooter and roguelike from Vlambeer, where each mutant character has its own abilities. Some characters only unlock after you meet particular conditions.
in the game sonic forces, which of the f: Infinite is the villain created for Sonic Forces (2017), a masked jackal who wields the Phantom Ruby. The other characters in the game had already appeared in earlier Sonic titles.
what happened to half-life 2 prior to it: In 2003, hackers stole Half-Life 2's source code and leaked it online, a major setback that contributed to the release being pushed back to November 2004. Valve and its president, Gabe Newell, publicly asked fans for help finding the culprit.
in the game tom clancy's rainbow 6 siege: Valkyrie, from Rainbow Six Siege, is Meghan Castellano, a former US Navy SEAL. She deploys cameras that give her team extra information.
how many playable characters were there: Street Fighter II: Champion Edition (1992) made the four boss characters playable, bringing the roster to 12. It also allowed mirror matches, so two players could pick the same fighter.
who's the creator of geometry dash?: Geometry Dash was made by Robert Topala, who goes by "RobTop", a Swedish developer. The rhythm-based platformer came out in 2013 and is known for being hard.
in the beginning of the game \"sonic adv: Sonic Adventure (1998) was Sonic's first fully 3D adventure on the Sega Dreamcast. It gave each of several characters, including Tails and Knuckles, their own storylines.
during the game's development, what was: The Rhyhorn family, Rhyhorn and its evolution Rhydon, is usually named as the first Pokémon designed during development. It was drawn by Kouji Nishino for the original Game Boy games.
in monster hunter generations, which of: The "Fated Four" in Monster Hunter Generations are Mizutsune, Astalos, Gammoth and Glavenus. Astalos is an electric flying wyvern that looks like a bat-winged dragon.
in \"clash royale\" what is arena 4 call: Clash Royale's arenas are themed battlegrounds you unlock as you earn trophies, and their order has changed over time as updates added new ones. Spell Valley is one of the early arenas.
in minecraft: java edition, which of the: Beds were added in Minecraft Beta 1.3 in 2011. Sleeping skips the night and sets your spawn point.
in the mario series, which game introduc: Mario's backflip first appeared in the 1994 Game Boy version of Donkey Kong, which began as a remake of the arcade game and then added around 100 levels. Super Mario 64 later made the move famous.
which team won the first overwatch leagu: The London Spitfire won the first Overwatch League championship in 2018, beating the Philadelphia Fusion in the Grand Finals. The league used a city-based team format similar to traditional sports.
in overwatch, how old is reinhardt wilhe: Reinhardt Wilhelm, Overwatch's armored German knight, is 61 years old. He is a veteran of the Omnic Crisis who fights with a rocket hammer and a large energy shield.
what was the name of the secret organiza: In Hotline Miami, a shadowy group called the 50 Blessings sends coded phone messages that set up the protagonist's violent missions. The game's neon style and soundtrack are widely praised.
which horror movie had a sequel in the f: The Thing, a 2002 game, was a sequel to John Carpenter's 1982 horror film of the same name. It continued the movie's story of an alien that can imitate people.
which musical artist was not featured as: DJ Hero (2009) was a rhythm game with a turntable controller, featuring avatars of real DJs and artists like Daft Punk, Grandmaster Flash and DJ Shadow. Dr. Dre was not one of the playable avatars.
in the game destiny, who succeeded peter: Nolan North replaced Peter Dinklage as the voice of Ghost, the companion robot in Destiny. Dinklage's flat delivery was widely mocked by fans, and Bungie re-recorded the lines for Destiny 2.
in \"sonic the hedgehog 2\" for the sega: On the Sega Genesis, entering the sound-test numbers 19, 65, 09, 17 unlocks the level select in Sonic the Hedgehog 2. Those numbers are the September 17, 1965, birthday of Sonic Team's lead programmer, Yuji Naka.
which kingdom hearts game featured the c: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance (2012) included characters from The World Ends With You, including Neku. Both games were made by Square Enix.
where are terror fiends more commonly fo: Miitopia is a Nintendo role-playing game for the 3DS where the cast is made from Mii characters, so friends, family and celebrities can play the heroes. Monsters called Terror Fiends appear in specific regions of the game.
what was the world's first video game?: A draughts (checkers) program written by Christopher Strachey around 1951 and 1952 is counted among the first computer games. OXO (1952) and Tennis for Two (1958) are also often called the first.
in the animal crossing series, which flo: In Animal Crossing, players can grow and cross-breed flowers, and in-game descriptions can use informal or alternate names. Lily of the valley is a white, bell-shaped flower in the games.
in the nintendo game splatoon 2, what is: Marina is half of the in-game pop duo Off the Hook in Splatoon 2, with Pearl. She uses the DJ name "DJ Hyperfresh".
which one of these characters appeared i: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite (2017) brings Marvel and Capcom fighters together in two-character teams that use the powers of the Infinity Stones. Its roster mixes comic-book heroes with video-game icons.
